members.member:
========================================================================== Public Method : GetStringValue
Retrieves a Single StringValue associated with the enum. Returns the preferred StringValue if multiple are defined.
If no preferred value is specified, or if multiple preferred values are specified, returns any arbitrary one of the values (selected from the preferred values in the latter case.
Returns the Enum name, if no StringValue was specified at all.
==========================================================================

========================================================================== Public Method : GetAllStringValues
Retrieves the full Collection of StringValues associated with the particular enum (including the Enum's name) If no StringValues are specified, then returns ONLY the Enum's name.
==========================================================================

========================================================================== Method : GetStringValuesWithPreferences
Retrieves the StringValueAttributes associated with the enum. If no StringValues are specified, defaults to treating the EnumName as the implicit StringValue.
==========================================================================

========================================================================== Public Extension Method on System.String: ParseToEnum
Retrieves the Enum matching the string passed in. Throws if no match was found.
"TEnumType : struct, IConvertible" is the closest you can get to "TEnumType : Enum"
This should minimise the chances of run-time errors by catching most of them at compile time.
==========================================================================

========================================================================== Public Extension Method on List{String}: ParseToEnumList
Iterates over the collection of string, calling ParseToEnum on each one.
Will throw if ANY of the values are unmatchable.
Calls ToList() to force immediate instantiation and thus immediate failure if any values aren't matched.
==========================================================================

========================================================================== Public Method : TryParseStringValueToEnum
Retrieves the Enum matching the string passed in. Returns true or false according to whether a match was found.
"TEnumType : struct, IConvertible" is the closest you can get to "TEnumType : Enum"
This should minimise the chances of run-time errors by catching most of them at compile time.
==========================================================================
